address: Immeuble Kalinka, La Tania, Courchevel, 73120, France
bio: Tucked away in the charming resort of La Tania, a stone's throw from Courchevel, Julien Machet's restaurant invites you to enjoy a culinary experience that is full of personality. Accessible on skis, this unique place sets itself apart with its inspired and authentic cuisine in which local ingredients from Savoie, Piedmont and the Mediterranean rub shoulders with carefully selected ingredients from neighbouring regions. The chef brings out the best in this produce, thanks to contemporary creativity and flawless technique, creating dishes with intense and perfectly balanced flavours. Pies with golden lids, fragrant sauces, nods to Sicily… each dish tells a delicious and unexpected story. A bright and authentic place at high altitude....
